svg.text: One shared cognitive runtime · agents added by configuration · model-, warehouse- and cloud-neutral · SAP-compliant
→ registered as one governed, runnable Agent Manifest (agent-as-configuration)
Seven shared layers — built once, reused by every capability
Lightweight tool packs — the only domain-specific code (the “thin executors”)
persisted canonical graph, reusable across sessions
Warehouse connectors are read-only & guarded (SELECT-only); writes are governed and human-gated. Same ontology across all three = zero re-mapping.
Build cognition once; attach thin executors. Every deployment teaches the ontology library — so onboarding gets faster and smarter over time.
UNAI · Universal Agentic Runtime — Bristlecone · Confidential
